item.title: Job Search Skills
item.description:
Problem it solves

Most job-search prompts and skills stop at resume polishing or generic interview questions. This suite treats job search as a reusable operating system: build a candidate evidence base, parse JDs into structured requirements, map evidence to requirements, adapt materials truthfully, and feed real interview outcomes back into later applications.

What is included

  • 2 orchestrator skills + 15 specialist skills, callable independently or composable into a full pipeline;
  • Works for internships, campus recruiting, experienced hiring, and career switching;
  • Includes a dedicated orchestrator for AI product manager, LLM application, Agent/RAG product, model platform, and AI evaluation roles.

Scope

The goal is not a fake-perfect resume. It is to make every application more explainable, evidence-based, and consistent. Users must supply their own real experience and materials — the suite does not fabricate.
